from ninja import Router, Schema
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import DeviceTelemetryConfig

class StreamDestinationSchema(Schema):
    destination_url: str
    auth_token: str

router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@router.post("/devices/{device_uuid}/telemetry-stream")
def reconfigure_telemetry_stream(request, device_uuid: str, data: StreamDestinationSchema):
    telemetry_config = get_object_or_404(
        DeviceTelemetryConfig,
        device__uuid=device_uuid,
        device__fleet__organization=request.auth.organization
    )
    telemetry_config.destination_url = data.destination_url
    telemetry_config.stream_token = data.auth_token
    telemetry_config.is_streaming = True
    telemetry_config.save()
    return {"status": "streaming_configured", "device_uuid": device_uuid}
